description: What a time in one place is in other places, with daylight saving applied for that date. Name zones the IANA way (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, America/New_York, Europe/London, Australia/Sydney) or UTC. Free.

date.description: The date in from_zone, like 2026-11-05. Default: today in from_zone.

from_zone.description: The zone the time is in, like Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

time.description: The time on a 24-hour clock, like 09:30 or 21:00. Default: now.

to_zones.description: The zones to show it in, like ["America/New_York", "Europe/London"].

name: convert_time
title: Convert a time between time zones
